subject: Exec signalboard — customer health, renewal risk & Q3 prep
messages:
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Exec signalboard — Brightworks & Elara prep (renewal watch)

Team — putting together a concise signalboard for Friday's leadership Q3 prep; two customers look like they should be on the exec watch list and I want alignment on priority asks. High level:

- Brightworks (renewal Oct 1) — usage steady but a growing latency/regression spike reported last month; procurement has signaled potential replacement conversations unless we show plan.
- Elara Health (renewal Nov 15) — expanding into additional product lines; asking for committed SLA language and tighter data residency guarantees.

Action items: please review the attached heatmap and send your short bullets (1-2 lines each) for the exec summary:
- Laura: health signals + any escalations from CS
- Vivek: recommended remediation and timeline we can commit to for Brightworks
- Aditya: pricing/terms levers for Elara if they ask for a mid-contract credit or change in SLA
- Marcus: one-liner ask we'd put in the exec slide (e.g., "Approve 30-day tactical credits" or "Escalate to infra for priority kernel tuning")

Attachments: 2027_Q3_renewal_heatmap.xlsx (heatmap tab + notes), redwood_healthplaybook.pdf (exec bullets).

Goal: 1 page signalboard + 3-slide appendix for Friday 10:00 leadership prep. Please reply by EOD today with your bullets.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Head of Customer Insight (Sales Ops)
Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com
Cc: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com, aditya.rao@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec signalboard — Brightworks & Elara prep (renewal watch)

Thanks — brief notes below (pulling from CS and AM threads):

Brightworks:
- Health: monthly token spend flat; conversational error rate up ~1.6% (vs baseline 0.4%) since 2027-04-12 after a model patch.
- Customer sentiment: CS flagged an "availability" worry in their biweekly; they called out 3 incidents impacting 10% of user sessions.
- Current mitigations: rolling back the patch reduced errors to 0.9% but root cause still unclear.
- Exec ask suggestion: commit to a joint RCA with customer by 5/28 and a 30-day performance SLA pilot; if missed, propose a one-time credit.

Elara Health:
- Health: adoption expanding; they want a written SLA and proof of residency controls (they're sensitive to EU data for certain product lines).
- Procurement is pushing for specific KMS/HSM integration checkpoints and longer retention guarantees.
- Exec ask suggestion: approve a phased commitment: (a) confirm residency options + KMS checklist in 2 weeks, (b) provide sample SLA language to legal this week.

I'll attach the CS thread export in a follow-up note (redacted). Short and actionable.

- Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Customer Success
Redwood Inference
From: vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: aditya.rao@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-18T15:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec signalboard — Brightworks & Elara prep (renewal watch)

Quick remediation & ask recommendations from infra/ops POV:

Brightworks remediation (priority):
- Immediate: enable a canary revert to pre-patch kernel across 10% of their traffic within 24 hours (ops ticket #BRW-881).
- Near-term (7 days): deep KV cache tracing + tokenization consistency check to isolate regression vector.
- Timeline we can sign: 7-day tactical window for mitigation; 28-day incremental performance SLA pilot (metrics defined in appendix).
- Exec ask: approve dedicated infra priority lane for Brightworks triage (SLA: 48hr escalations).

Elara asks (lower infra risk, legal/product heavy):
- We can document residency and KMS options; need legal sign-off on template SLA.
- Recommend offering a "residency assessment checklist" and commit to a 14-day technical review.

Attachment: ops ticket stubs referenced inline.

On Fri's slides: I can take a single remediation slide for Brightworks and a short bullets slide for Elara.

— Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Reliability & Ops
Redwood Inference
From: aditya.rao@redwood.com
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com, vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-19T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Exec signalboard — Brightworks & Elara prep (renewal watch)

Pricing/terms POV — short bullets for exec deck: 

Brightworks:
- Offer: 30-day tactical credit up to $15k contingent on completion of RCA and performance pilot (to be reflected in a one-page amendment).
- Rationale: preserves commercial relationship while giving us runway to isolate regression; reduces churn risk vs a discounted price.

Elara:
- Offer: No immediate credit; propose a short-term SLA addendum (2 quarters) and a committed residency assessment at no charge. If they ask for a credit, cap at $10k tied to delivery milestones.

Exec ask recommendations (single-line options):
- "Approve Brightworks tactical credit (≤$15k) + infra priority lane."
- "Authorize legal to circulate Elara sample SLA and residency checklist this week."

I'll be on the 10:00 call.

Aditya Rao
Director, Commercial Deals
Redwood Inference
